# Results walkthrough: index and provenance

*Generated by `eval/figs_results_walkthrough.py` at commit `35b22bc`. This script only COMPOSES pages: it places existing, cross-checked images (thesis figures, summary charts, and the all-flights plots of `eval/figs_walkthrough_flights.py`, whose own checks are in `flights/index_flights.md`); nothing is re-plotted, recomputed or re-run here. All provenance is here; the pages carry none.*

**All-flights plots (ruling 2026-10-21):** 44/44 printed-number checks and 104/104 data-identity checks pass (`docs/thesis/summary/flights/index_flights.md`, sha256 `c8265d2d38fd863b9f86e5367c853e8bff0a675c33c6b2e680d475a8ba2a7e42`). The world page appears once per experiment, after its last plot page.

**Checks:** 128/128 reused lines equal their source string exactly; 12 lines MODIFIED (each listed with its original); 47 NEW lines (number guard: every number in a NEW or MODIFIED line occurs in the figure's own index entry or in that page's summary strings: PASS); world check 9/9 page groups match the trials' recorded worlds. Failures: none.

**Text source.** Reused lines come from `docs/thesis/summary/index_summary.md`, which `eval/figs_thesis_summary.py` writes from the same strings it draws on the summary pages. Before building, that script was re-run on a scratch copy at HEAD `441e97c` with only its output folder redirected: the regenerated `index_summary.md` was identical apart from its commit line, and all 13 summary PNGs were byte-identical to the committed ones; the footer-rule rows used to crop the summary charts (`top` + 0.012 = 0.2945 / 0.266 / 0.323 / 0.2945 / 0.323 for summary pages 02 / 03 / 10 / 11 / 12) come from that run and are asserted on the committed PNGs at build time. The five closed-loop check phrases inserted into the with-heading 1C pass rule are asserted to occur in `eval/figs_thesis_summary.py`.

**Layout.** A4 landscape; PNGs at 200 dpi; images embedded unresampled (`interpolation='none'`). Text ≥ 11 pt (Metric, Pass rule, Result, About, world captions: 11 pt; What this tests: 12.5 pt; titles 16.5 pt). 'scale' below = displayed width ÷ the image's width at 200 dpi (the summary charts are 150 dpi images and are never enlarged beyond their own size).

**PDF:** `results_walkthrough.pdf` = contents (`walkthrough/wt_00a_contents.png`), 'How to read these pages' (the summary's `summary_00_how_to_read.png`, sha256 `6a3bd6d2e50d98eb3d357b0c2969414043f628b82f2d2160e89b1a62b21ddadf`, placed full page unchanged), then pages 01–28 below (39 PDF pages in all).

**Contents-page note (NEW):** Each experiment starts with where the drone really flew, then its plots showing every flight (one panel per estimator, never drawn on top of each other), each with what it shows, the metric, the pass rule and the result; the simulated world it was flown in follows once, after the experiment's last plot. Where an experiment has no per-flight plot, its summary chart is shown.

| What this tests | VERBATIM | summary page 01, what | equal | How accurately three position estimators track a drone along a long indoor corridor with no GPS, using only motion sensors, a downward camera and a height sensor. |
| About this plot | NEW | new (this script) | numbers found | where the drone really was in all 9 flights, from the simulator. | Pass rule | VERBATIM | summary page 01, rule | equal | EKF3 and the FGO were ranked only if one was lower on at least 6 of 7 further flights AND the 95% confidence interval of the difference excluded zero (the same rule either way); no ranking rule was registered for the UKF. |
| Result | VERBATIM | summary page 01, result | equal | NOT MET: on the further flights EKF3 was lower on 5 of 7 and the interval (−0.989 to +0.947 m) includes zero, so no estimator is ranked above another. |

## Not included, and why

- **Figure 3.1 (system architecture):** method, not a result.
- **Tables A.1–A.3 and the other thesis tables:** tables, not time-series or path plots; their pass/fail content is in the summary lines already shown.
- **Summary charts kept** (no per-flight time series made here): the blank floor (page 06), the 1B heading check (07), Experiment 5 hold (25) and tag loss (26), 5S (28). Their per-flight error-against-time views were not built in this stage (blank floor: the +10/+30 s values of blank_behaviour.json would be the identity check; Experiment 5: hold and loss windows from expH json); the blank floor and the 1B heading check also have no 'where the drone flew' page (offline, truth-flying corridor flights, the same straight line as page 01).
- **Replaced by all-flights plots:** Figure 4.2 (R3, one flight), Figure 4.1c (R5, one flight, error against distance), Figures 4.1 and 4.1b (F2, F9: estimators overlaid) and Figure 5.3 (F6, flight 1 of 3). Experiment 2's error against time per flight was not built (Figure 5.1 already shows every flight as a small mark).
- **No onboard frame of the half-and-half floor with plain walls** exists (`world_images/index.md` §4); the 1B world page notes that the half-and-half floor is not pictured.
